t: You're looking at Winfield House, an English townhouse in Regent's Park and the official residence of the United States ambassador to the United Kingdom. Its grounds cover twelve acres, the second largest private garden in London after the garden of Buckingham Palace. The architect was Leonard Rome Guthrie, a Scottish architect who joined the Wimperis and Simpson partnership in 1925. One ambassador who lived here was Woody Johnson, who served from 2017 to 2021 and also owns the New York Jets.
